director.text: Namaste Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher hoon. Aaj cricket ground ke chakkar jaisa perimeter padhenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
haan
Cricket ground ke boundary ke chaaron taraf chalna perimeter hai—poori boundary ki length. Tum boundary kaise naapogi?
step by step samjhao
Dheere chalenge. Perimeter matlab polygon ki sabhi sides ko jodna. Rectangle mein kitni sides hoti hain?
chhota bolo
Theek hai, Riya—ab chhote steps. Rectangle ki boundary: length do baar aur breadth do baar; perimeter kaise likhogi?
pehle picture dikhao
Riya, picture ko words mein dekho: rectangle ki lambi sides 50 m, chhoti sides 30 m. Kaunsi sides same hain?
pata nahi
Riya, rectangle ki opposite sides same hoti hain: do 50 m, do 30 m. Ab perimeter ke liye sab sides jodo—kitna?
kuch aur baat karte hain
Haan Riya, lesson ek minute ruk sakta hai. Kis baare mein baat karni hai? Screen ka button dabakar lesson par laut sakti ho.
cricket ke baare mein
Cricket par baat karte hain—tumne kaha tha, yaad hai. Lesson ke end mein cricket wali baat par zaroor lautenge; ab card ka chhota step dekho. Khaali jagah bharo: 3 × 160 = ___ m.
hindi mein batao
Riya, ise Hindi mein samjhenge. Pehle dekho: teen samooh hain, har samooh mein 160 meter. Khaali jagah bharo: 3 × 160 = ___ m.
mujhe khud try karne do
Bilkul, Riya. Pehle tum khud poora try karo; main tumhare jawab ke baad hi madad karungi. Khaali jagah bharo: 3 × 160 = ___ m.
bye
Theek hai, Riya. Tum rukna chahti ho—carry on, chhota break, ya aaj ke liye band?
